findings.description: delete_entry checks only _require_reader, which passes for any user in entry.readers. A shared reader can therefore call delete_entry and permanently remove an entry they do not own, along with its data for the owner and all other readers. Only the owner should be able to delete it, as the error message in leave_entry and the owner-only edit/share/unshare handlers imply.
findings.suggestion: Replace _require_reader(entry, user) with _require_owner(entry, user) in delete_entry.
findings.title: Any reader can delete a journal entry
